fullTextEN: Hello everyone, I am Fan Fan.

fullTextZH: 今天我邀请了一位特别的客人。
fullTextEN: Today I invited a special guest.
She is Fan Fan from 10 years ago.

fullTextZH: 所以呢，也是她24岁的生日。

fullTextEN: Also wish you a happy birthday.
You should sleep early every day,

fullTextZH: 这十年你都是凌晨3点才睡觉的。
fullTextEN: For these ten years, you have been sleeping at 3 AM.
How about now, are you busy?
But no longer working at the university.
The current job is more interesting.

fullTextZH: 每天和很厉害的学生一起聊天。
fullTextEN: Chat with very talented students every day.

fullTextZH: 你猜我现在年纪最大的学生多少岁？
fullTextEN: Can you guess how old my oldest student is now?
Still learning Chinese at 80 years old?

fullTextZH: 厉害，现在的工作赚钱多吗？
fullTextEN: Impressive, does your current job pay well?
Passed away? Where did he go?
He went to a very, very far place.
He passed away the year before last.

fullTextZH: 不过我和咱妈后面一直陪着她，
fullTextEN: But my mom and I stayed with her all the time,

fullTextZH: 给她做很多好吃的东西。
fullTextEN: Made her lots of delicious food.
but I really did my best.

fullTextZH: 还有爷爷和姥姥也走了。
fullTextEN: Also, grandpa and grandma have passed away.

fullTextZH: 所以你一定要记得多回家看看，
fullTextEN: So you must remember to visit home often,
spend the Spring Festival with them.
Our dad doesn't want us to cry.

fullTextZH: 咱爸，还有爷爷、姥姥，都希望我们开心。
fullTextEN: Our dad, and grandpa, grandma, all want us to be happy.

fullTextZH: 而且在你的时间里，她们都还在呀。
fullTextEN: Besides, in your time, they are all still here.
So you are happier than me.
When did you start liking cats?

fullTextZH: 你以前不是最怕猫了吗？
fullTextEN: Weren't you most afraid of cats before?
Then where does your husband sleep?
Sister, I haven't even married yet.

fullTextZH: 以前不是说30岁的时候结婚吗？
fullTextEN: Didn't you say you'd marry at 30?
How come you're 34 and still not married?

fullTextZH: 结不结婚没有那么重要吧。
fullTextEN: Getting married isn't that important, right?
Let me see, let me see.

fullTextZH: 大学宿舍的那几个朋友怎么样了？
fullTextEN: How are those friends from the university dorm?

fullTextZH: 我现在不需要什么朋友。
fullTextEN: I don't need any friends right now.
I chat with colleagues every day,
I have a class in a bit.
It's not easy for us to meet.

fullTextZH: 你现在能不能给我点建议，
fullTextEN: Can you give me some advice now,

fullTextZH: 我好像没什么能给你的建议。
fullTextEN: I don't seem to have any advice to give you.
I don't know you well yet.

fullTextZH: 你会因为今天我跟你说了什么，
fullTextEN: Will you change your thoughts and choices because of what I said to you today?

fullTextZH: 改变自己的想法和选择吗？
fullTextEN: Will you change your thoughts and choices?
Yes, but in the next 10 years,

fullTextZH: 我希望你想做什么就去做，
fullTextEN: I hope you do whatever you want to do,
Learn whatever you want to learn,

fullTextZH: 也许你做了和我不一样的选择，
fullTextEN: Maybe you made different choices than I did,

fullTextZH: 我们会成为不一样的人呢。
我对你现在的男朋友还挺感兴趣的。
fullTextEN: I'm quite interested in your current boyfriend.
By the way, it's not easy for you to come here,
Why do I need a mask?
Trust me, you'll definitely use it.

fullTextZH: 明天晚上的彩票号码是多少？
fullTextEN: What are the lottery numbers for tomorrow night?
Forget it if you won't say.
Actually, I want to say: move forward,
